scientific_choices.choice: BLIP2 scene descriptions; MPNet cosine, semantic T1/T3 candidate choice, alpha0.6 beta0.4 tau0.8 and full-image DeepSolo fallback; Algorithm2 strict > ties choose T3.

User requests T3 as all frozen crop words, including repeated/ignored/empty outputs without confidence filtering; same bbox top/left order and space join as CLIP. Paper multiple-crop aggregation remains unresolved.

Use prose confidence of the semantic winner; accept T1 only when its C1 passes the same threshold, outputting exactly one raw PARSeq sequence, or accept all T3 crop predictions when selected C3 passes. Otherwise full-image DeepSolo. This user clarification supersedes the former T1-winner veto; keep the joined-T3-only gate as an ablation.
Use original pinned BLIP2 FlanT5-XL/MPNet/PARSeq candidates, raw RapidFuzz ratio and frozen epoch61 words/evaluation branches. This does not identify the exact paper checkpoints.

Single paragraph prompt restates visible Figure4 instructions and adds40..80 word target. Structured profile asks four image-only questions and joins raw answers with punctuation; not strict paper captioning. Do not append PARSeq/GT, pad repetitive output or trim raw captions to claim quality.

Paper tau0.8 remains reference for either selected T1 or T3; additional thresholds and matched62 TRAIN/149 TEST image budgets are exploratory, with50% calibration cut on TRAIN80 and no TEST selection. MPNet context overflow forces fallback, preserving all raw words.

Sequential models, BLIP2 FP32 CPU or explicit FP16 CUDA profile; optional CPU offload with declared6GiB GPU weight budget; batch1, MPNet FP32 CPU, deterministic kernels/TF32 off. Measure GPU peaks and propagate OOM; no quantization/model substitution.

Paper checkpoint, full caption prompt/decoding, words-vs-tokens, fuzzy preprocessing and score conflict remain unresolved. Caption visual fidelity is reviewed without GT; full425 captions and missing TRAIN DeepSolo require GPU host; all results approximate and exploratory.

A separate single-long diagnostic sets min_new_tokens60 with no-repeat3/repetition penalty1.15 to test whether the repository BLIP2 model supplies additional real scene details rather than merely short answers. Forced length can hallucinate/repeat and is not evidence of Figure4 equivalence; raw output, quality and independent visual review are preserved, no length padding/repair or GT optimization.

Additional image-only grounded profile asks six simple environment/object/color/position/background questions, using min_new_tokens0. It avoids forced-length filler, preserves raw answers and remains a separate approximation requiring visual review. Primary caption profile is not selected using recognition accuracy or TEST data.

T1 PARSeq uses FP32 CPU batch1 explicitly even when BLIP2 runs on CUDA, allowing stable reuse of whole-image T1 cache between caption devices. Its hardware/latency remains separate from crop recognition and paper performance.

InstructBLIP is a separate explicitly named instruction-caption ablation using its own already-cached checkpoint/revision/shard hashes, not the BLIP2 paper baseline. A TRAIN image-only probe produced51 words/3 sentences closer in style but imperfect literal transcription; no TEST correctness selects the caption model. Primary paper baseline remains figure4_single/BLIP2.

Reuse new425-image CPU FP32 T1 results via immutable manifest, shard/plan hashes and checks for actual original RGB identities, native PARSeq preprocessing/decoding, checkpoint/source recipe, recognizer code and identical software. Preserve original metadata; caption/profile changes do not re-label outputs as newly generated.

Because T1 supplies one unlocalized sequence, the primary comparison uses per-image one-to-one casefold-exact word matching without bbox IoU for T1/T3/DeepSolo and replayed frozen CLIP decisions alike. T1 is one prediction without whitespace splitting or fabricated bbox and is always care. Existing T3/DeepSolo ignored-region flags and invalid-envelope FP handling remain; separate geometry diagnostics preserve the previous IoU protocol. Pin all original annotation/report/audit sources; reading annotations never affects routing.
